q: Around _____ of 118 elements in the Periodic Table are classified as metals.
e: Around 95 of 118 elements in the Periodic Table are classified as metals. Most of the 118 elements are metals, which is why the reactivity series is such a large part of this chapter. 95 is the word this version is asking about.

q: The reactivity series of metals is a series in which metals are arranged in order of reactivity from _____.
e: The reactivity series of metals is a series in which metals are arranged in order of reactivity from highest to lowest. The reactivity series ranks metals from most reactive to least reactive. Highest to lowest is the word this version is asking about.

q: Metals above carbon can only be extracted from their ores by _____.
e: Metals above carbon can only be extracted from their ores by electrolysis. Metals above carbon are too reactive for carbon reduction, so they are extracted by electrolysis. Metals above carbon in the series cannot be smelted with carbon and need electrolysis.
